evidence.detail: No results — no 'best player with this card' feature exists anywhere in decksite views, data, or templates
wilson_lower_bound_sql() exists and is used for archetype/card ranking but not for per-player-per-card statistics
Card detail view exists but shows no per-player win-rate breakdown
load_cards queries aggregate across all players; no player-level breakdown for a specific card

triage.notes: Requires a new SQL query joining card plays, decks, and person win records grouped by player for a specific card; a minimum-decks threshold (Wilson score was suggested in comments); a new section on the card detail page; and template work. More than 150 lines and involves non-trivial design decisions about display placement and threshold selection.
